checks: Paused cues distinguish Place, continuing Hold, the next note through a rest, and Rest after the final note; pitch octaves and named fingers agree with key guidance
Real Wait-mode chord input advances to Play F4 while both written C notes remain Hold; a wrong MIDI pitch cannot advance
Guidance follows the selected hand and phrase; a next-bar note outside the active phrase is hidden until repeat is disabled

Finger guide releases an already-held key, suppresses computer/MIDI/pedal input, mirrors finger selection, separates pitch from finger numbers, and restores focus/input after Escape; delayed settings can unmount the open guide without leaving computer or MIDI input locked
Live reduced motion preserves the instructional cues; hiding and restoring hands keeps the same musical position and the hand canvases stay pointer-transparent
